Experience refined luxury in this exceptional 6-bedroom villa located in the prestigious Grand Views community in Meydan, offering expansive living spaces, premium finishes, and an elegant lifestyle.

Property Features:

6 Spacious Bedrooms
Maid's Room
Driver's Room
8 Bathrooms
Expansive Living & Dining Areas
Modern Closed Kitchen with High-End Finishes
Family Lounge
Private Landscaped Garden
Large Terrace & Balconies
Covered Parking
Floor-to-Ceiling Windows
Built-in Wardrobes
Premium Quality Finishes
Vacant / Ready to Move

Community Features:

Gated Community with 24/7 Security
Swimming Pool
Fully Equipped Gym
Children's Play Area
Landscaped Parks & Walking Tracks
Cycling & Jogging Paths
Family-Friendly Environment
Easy Access to Downtown Dubai
Close to Meydan Racecourse
Nearby Schools, Retail & Dining Options

Perfectly positioned in the heart of Meydan, this luxurious villa offers an outstanding blend of privacy, space, and convenience with seamless connectivity to Dubai's key destinations.
